title: Hardware-Aware Design and Layout Selection in Quantum Reservoir Computing for Insurance Claims Forecasting
summary: For next-day motor-insurance claims, a six-qubit reservoir was evaluated on held-out days and IBM quantum hardware. Hardware-aware placement reduced simulation-to-device forecast distortion relative to tested layouts; forecasting accuracy was comparable with classical baselines on this task.
ai_technology: Quantum reservoir computing with learned linear readout; hardware-aware layout selection
